Jalapeno Queso With Goat Cheese
By: Corrinne
Published: Thursday, February 3, 2011 - 1:31pm

Ingredients




1 package (5.3 oz) Fresh Goat Cheese, such as Chavrie
8 oz. can diced tomatoes, drained
1 ea. jalapeno pepper diced
2 teaspoons hot sauce

Preparation

1 Mix all ingredients in a glass bowl and slowly heat in the microwave until piping hot. 2 Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste.
